descriptions: Blakebeard likes to keep a few spares stashed away.
Assault Weapon: Art Deco.  A versatile assault rifle useful in all types of combat scenarios that is the most accurate when aiming down sights and firing in controlled bursts.

Assault Weapon: Fully Automatic. Flexible assault rifle capable of handling all types of combat scenarios. High rate of fire with solid accuracy when aiming down sights and firing in controlled bursts.

Assault Weapon: Fully Automatic. Flexible assault rifle capable of handling all types of combat scenarios. High rate of fire with solid accuracy when aiming down sights and firing in controlled bursts.

"Don't worry, we'll give you a running start." - Ramirez
Assault Weapon: Fully Automatic. A spooky assault rifle that fires medium ammo, gaining damage and impact at the cost of accuracy and fire rate.

Assault Weapon: Energy Burst. Assault rifle that fires accurate bursts of highly damaging energy, with a significant ammo cost. Deals energy damage which is fairly effective against all elemental enemy types.
SMG. Mid ranged SMG with a high capacity magazine and a lateral kick. Its shooting profile makes it ideal for clearing groups of nearby enemies in mobile engagements.
SMG: Mid ranged assault weapon with a high capacity magazine and a lateral kick. Its shooting profile makes it ideal for clearing groups of nearby enemies in mobile engagements.
High capacity, wild firing rifle. While this weapon is held, wildlife will not attack unless provoked.
Assault Rifle: Boombox. A higher than average impact assault rifle that fires two shot bursts at a steady rate and pierces enemies.
Assault Weapon: Burst. An assault rifle that fires tight bursts that allow for precise targeting in mobile mid-range engagements. Deals good damage, but consumes its magazine very quickly.
Assault Rifle: Retro Sci-Fi. Shoots rapid burst shots of energy at a fast rate. Deals energy damage, which is fairly effective against all types of elemental enemies.
A self-reloading heavy assault rifle that is a favored weapon of the Dark Voyager's forces. It fires small explosive cubes that detonate on impact, being specially effective against structures.

Assault Weapon: Burst Semi-Automatic. Fires a highly accurate two bullet burst, capable of dealing good damage at long range. Can throw lead downrange very quickly, but rewards careful aim with increased headshot damage.

Assault Weapon: Semi-Automatic. A rifle with modest rate of fire and capacity that penetrates numerous enemies and sets them on fire. Fire damage is effective against nature enemies, but weak against water enemies.
Assault Rifle: Spec Ops.  A high powered semi-automatic rifle with a small magazine that is most accurate when fired in short bursts.
Assault Weapon: Flintlock. A surprisingly accurate multi-barreled rifle that fires in powerful bursts. A high damage and large magazine help compensate for a slow fire rate and heavy kick.
Assault Weapon: Hydraulic. A hybrid weapon that fires a tight cluster of pellets, with considerably more knockback than an assault rifle, but better range and more focused damage than a shotgun.
Assault Weapon: Hydraulic. A slow firing high impact automatic rifle with a large magazine.
Fully Automatic when hip-fired, slower shots and extra headshot damage when aimed down sights.
Assault Weapon: Light Machine Gun. A heavy weapon with high damage, an extreme rate of fire, and a large magazine size. Inaccurate unless aiming down sights and firing in short bursts.

Assault Weapon: Light Machine Gun - Fortnitemares. A heavy, festive weapon with a huge magazine size full of candy shaped bullets. Most effective at mid-range engagements when aiming down sights from a fixed position.

Assault Weapon: Light Machine Gun - Military. A lighter LMG variant with a moderate rate of fire, mild recoil, a long reload time, and overall excellent ammo efficiency.  Best used when stationary, aiming down the sights, and firing in short bursts.

Assault Weapon: Light Machine Gun. A heavy weapon with high damage, an extreme rate of fire, and a huge magazine size. Very inaccurate unless aiming down sights from a fixed position, and firing in short bursts.
SMG: Medieval. Deals consistent damage to enemies at close to medium range, but falls off at longer ranges due to lower accuracy.

SMG: Military. Fast firing weapon with excellent damage output and magazine size, but lower range than most assault weapons. Maintains most of its accuracy while moving and firing from the hip, excelling at close range mobile skirmishes.
Assault Weapon: Burst - Military. A slow firing burst assault rifle with above average headshot damage and excellent stability.

Assault Weapon: Silenced - Military. A silenced assault rifle with excellent headshot damage and stability. Maintains impressive accuracy when fired in controlled bursts. Equipped with a suppressor that greatly reduces distance that enemies hear gunshots.
Assault Weapon: Precision Scoped - Military. A scoped assault rifle with high headshot damage and excellent stability. Effective at long ranges, but difficult to use up close.

Assault Rifle: Neon. A high damage light machine gun that's good for sustained fire due to the moderate rate of fire and huge magazine size. Very inaccurate when firing on the move. Deals energy damage, which is fairly effective against all types of elemental enemies.
Assault Rifle: Neon. Shoots highly accurate energized rounds at a moderate rate for high sustained damage. Deals energy damage, which is fairly effective against all types of elemental enemies.
Assault Weapon: Light Machine Gun - Rat Rod. Fast firing LMG with a large magazine size and ramp up time. Most effective at suppressing fire after fully ramping up.
Assault Weapon: Slug Gun - Rat Rod. Semi automatic rifle firing powerful rounds. Effective as a mid range rifle with a slow fire rate.
Assault Weapon: High Tech. A fully automatic laser gun with a quick rate of fire and decent accuracy. Deals energy damage, which is fairly effective against all types of elemental enemies.
Assault Weapon: Semi-Automatic. A versatile rifle that rewards careful aim with high headshot damage, but can be fired very rapidly in a pinch. Reduced durability, but much cheaper to craft.
Assault Weapon: Semi-Automatic. A versatile rifle that rewards careful aim with high headshot damage, but can be fired very rapidly in a pinch.
Assault Weapon: Semi-Automatic. This rifle is a clever girl that rewards careful aim with high headshot damage, but can be fired very rapidly in a pinch.
Assault Weapon: Semi-Automatic - Steampunk. A versatile rifle that deals steady damage.
Assault Rifle: Shoots highly accurate energized rounds at a moderate rate for high sustained damage. Deals energy damage, which is fairly effective against all types of elemental enemies.
Assault Weapon: Black Metal.  Fires Medium Ammo in 2 round bursts dealing moderate damage and heavy impact.
Assault Weapon: Slug Gun. A rifle that fires slugs with high damage and impact. Good accuracy, but relatively slow rate of fire, and high per-bullet cost.
This alien weapon emits a star-fueled laser blast.

SMG: Military. Rapid fire weapon that has minimal recoil and fast aim recovery, but with less accuracy or range than most assault weapons. Equipped with a suppressor that greatly reduces distance that enemies hear gunshots.
SMG: Military. Rapid fire weapon that has minimal recoil and fast aim recovery, but with less accuracy or range than most assault weapons.
Assault Rifle: Holiday Fun. A medium range semi-automatic assault rifle that uses medium ammo to shoot snowballs.
Assault Rifle: Steampunk. A high damage assault rifle that's good for sustained fire due to the slow rate of fire and large magazine capacity. Not very accurate when firing on the move.
Assault Rifle: Storm King. The Storm King’s Arm, forged into an assault rifle with excellent precision and damage.
Assault Weapon: Precision Burst. A burst-fire tactical assault rifle featuring a scope. Good damage and impact at long range, but consumes a lot of ammunition.
Assault Weapon: A semi-automatic electrical rifle with good accuracy. Deals nature damage that is effective against water enemies, but weak against fire enemies.
Assault Weapon: Winter. Assault rifle with a slow rate of fire that packs a punch per shot.  Slow and steady wins the race!

Club: Light - Holiday Fun. A fairly quick bat with higher than average impact and excellent knockback potential. Knockout Punch: Swing the bat like a golf club to perform an uppercut on your target dealing damage and extreme knockback.
Club: Medium. A sturdy golf club with a good balance of swing speed and knockback potential. Golf Swing: Heavy attack that deals increased damage and knockback.
Hardware: Medium - Art Deco.  A hammer that delivers high knockback at a decent swing rate. The Big Slam:  Heavy attack that knocks back foes.
Hardware: Boombox. A hammer with good attack speed and excellent impact. Bass Drop: Smash the ground, creating a series of sonic pulses that damage and knockback enemies.
Hardware: Flintlock. A hammer that delivers a hefty punch with slow, wide swings. Leap Attack: Heavy attack that jumps to a target area, damaging and knocking down nearby enemies.
Hardware: Heavy. A slow-swinging hammer with powerful knockback. Overhead Smash: Heavy attack that does increased damage and knockback.

Hardware: Heavy. A slow-swinging hammer that deals fire damage with powerful knockback. Overhead Smash: Heavy attack that does increased damage and knockback. Fire damage is effective against nature enemies, but weak against water enemies.
Hardware: Hydraulic. A hammer that delivers very high knockback at a slow swing rate. Hydraulic Smash: Heavy attack that knocks back foes.
Hardware: Medieval. A hefty spiked hammer with high impact and a moderate attack speed. Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes.
Hardware: Medium - Rat Rod. A fast-swinging hammer that gains speed with each hit. Leap Attack: Heavy attack that jumps to a target area, damaging and knocking down nearby enemies.
Hardware: Retro Sci-Fi. A hefty hammer with low impact and high damage. Blackhole: Heavy attack that pulls husks towards the hammer before dealing damage.

Hardware: High Tech. A rocket-powered hammer that delivers high knockback at a decent swing rate. Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes.
Hardware: High Tech. A rocket-powered hammer that delivers high knockback at a fast swing rate. Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes.
Hardware: Steampunk. A hammer that delivers a hefty punch with slow, wide swings. Steampunk Smash: Heavy attack that slams the ground damaging enemies around it.

Hardware: Storm King. The Storm King’s Hand, forged into a versatile hammer. (Ground) Meteor Slam: Heavy attack that slams the ground in front of you, damaging and knocking back nearby enemies. (Air) Leap Attack: Heavy attack that jumps to a target area, damaging and knocking down nearby enemies.
Club: Heavy - Flintlock. A heavy club with a slow swing speed and large knockback potential. Home Run: Heavy attack focused on impact and a knockback that will send enemies flying.
Club: Heavy. A large paddle with a slow swing speed and high knockback. Double Thwack: Heavy attack that damages and knocks back enemies in a wide forward cone.
Club: Light. A simple baseball bat with a fast swing speed but low damage and knockback. Home Run: Heavy attack focused on impact and a knockback that will send enemies flying.
Club: Medium - Boombox. A chunky microphone with excellent knockback potential. Feedback Pulse: Swing the mic head into the ground, blasting enemies in front of you with a sonic pulse.
Club: Light. A simple baseball bat with a fast swing speed but low damage and knockback. Double Thwack: Heavy attack that damages and knocks back enemies in a wide forward cone.
Club: Light - Retro Sci-Fi. A fairly quick bat with high damage and low impact. Energy Slam: Heavy attack that launches an explosive energy ball at enemies, dealing damage in an area.
Hardware: Light. A crowbar that combines a quick swing speed with good knockback potential. Overhead Smash: Heavy attack that does increased damage and knockback.
Hardware: Medium. A solid metal pipe with a moderate swing rate and good knockback. Overhead Smash: Heavy attack that does increased damage and knockback.
Hardware: Medium. A heavy wrench with a moderate swing rate and good knockback. Overhead Smash: Heavy attack that does increased damage and knockback.
Club: Medium - Rat Rod. A medium club with a good balance of damage and speed at the cost of lower impact. Home Run: Heavy attack focused on impact and a knockback that will send enemies flying.
Hardware: Light. A socket wrench that combines a quick swing speed with good knockback potential. Double Thwack: Heavy attack that damages and knocks back enemies in a wide forward cone.

Hardware: Light. An improvised pipe weapon that combines a quick swing speed with good knockback potential. Reduced durability, but much cheaper to craft. Double Thwack: Heavy attack that damages and knocks back enemies in a wide forward cone.

A creepy round-point shovel that looks like it has been used to dig up terrible secrets. The shovel handles like a lighter sledge hammer, with a better damage and less impact. Up and Over: A two strike heavy attack that deals significant damage and knockback.
Axe: Light - Holiday Fun. A light axe with a good balance of damage and impact. Jet-Fueled Blast: Slashes twice and finishes with a thrust that damages and knocks back enemies.

Axe: Medium - Art Deco.  Versatile weapon that combines a moderate swing speed with good damage and knockback.  Leap Attack: Heavy attack that jumps to a target area, damaging and knocking down nearby enemies.
Axe: Heavy - Black Metal. Deals moderate damage and heavy impact.  Maelstrom Attack:  Heavy attack that continuously spins while holding alternate fire.
Axe: Heavy. Slow-swinging axe that deals high damage and knockback. Delivers a clear message with every strike. Up and Over: A two strike heavy attack that deals significant damage and knockback.
Axe: Heavy. Slow-swinging axe that deals high damage and knockback. Up and Over: A two strike heavy attack that deals significant damage and knockback.
Axe: Heavy. Slow-swinging axe that is also good at stunning enemies. Deals nature damage that is effective against water enemies, but weak against fire enemies.
Axe: Light. A very fast improvised axe with fair damage and knockback. Double Thwack: Heavy attack that damages and knocks back enemies in a wide forward cone.
Axe: Light - Rat Rod. A light axe with a good balance of damage and impact. Push and Swipe: Two-strike heavy attack with increased damage and knock back.
Axe: Light. A fast-swinging improvised axe with moderate damage and knockback. Up and Over: A two strike heavy attack that deals significant damage and knockback.
Axe: Medieval. A large curved axe with a good mix of damage and impact. Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes.
Axe: Medium. Versatile weapon that combines a moderate swing speed with good damage and knockback. Push and Swipe: Two-strike heavy attack with increased damage and knock back.

Axe: High Tech. An energized blade with a good damage, moderate swing speed, and moderate knockback. Deals energy damage which is fairly effective against elemental enemies. Up and Over: A two strike heavy attack that deals significant damage and knockback.

Axe: Neon. Slow-swinging axe that deals energy damage, making it relatively effective against all elemental enemies. Up and Over: A two strike heavy attack that deals significant damage and knockback.
Axe: Heavy. Slow-swinging axe that deals high damage and knockback. Reduced durability, but much cheaper to craft. Up and Over: A two strike heavy attack that deals significant damage and knockback.

Axe: Light Energy. Fast-swinging axe that deals high damage, but relatively little knockback. Deals energy damage which is fairly effective against all types of elemental enemies. Double Chop: A two strike heavy attack that deals significant damage and knockback in a forward cone.
Sword: Medium - A very cool looking scimitar.
Scythe: Black Metal. Deals moderate damage and heavy impact in a wide arc.  Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes.
Scythe: Improvised. A slow weapon that deals high damage and moderate impact. Push and Swipe: Two-strike heavy attack with increased damage and knock back.
Scythe: Flintlock. A slow weapon that deals high damage and moderate impact in a wide arc. Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes.

Scythe: High Tech. A slow weapon that deals high damage and fair impact. Deals energy damage which is fairly effective against elemental enemies. Push and Swipe: Two-strike heavy attack with increased damage and knock back.

Scythe: Neon. A quick weapon that cleaves enemies in a wide arc. Deals energy damage which is fairly effective against elemental enemies. Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes.
Scythe: Heavy. A slow weapon that deals high damage and moderate impact. Push and Swipe: Two-strike heavy attack with increased damage and knock back.
Steampunk. A moderate speed weapon that deals moderate damage in a wide arc. Maelstrom Attack: Heavy attack continuously spins while holding alternate fire.
Sword: Medium - Art Deco. Uses a fast attack speed to deal high sustained damage.  Maelstrom Attack:  Heavy attack that continuously spins while holding alternate fire.
Sword: Heavy - Black Metal. A large sword with moderate damage and high impact.  Leap Attack: Heavy attack that jumps to a target area, damaging and knocking down nearby enemies.
Edged: Winter. Slow edged weapon with high damage. Double Slash: Damages and knocks back enemies in a wide cone.

Sword: Heavy. A slower sword with high fire damage and moderate impact. Double Slash: Damages and knocks back enemies in a wide cone. Fire damage is effective against nature enemies, but weak against water enemies.
Sword: Medium. Uses an above average attack speed to deal high sustained damage, with moderate impact. Spectral Slash: Warp to the targeted enemy, dealing heavy damage. May stagger smaller enemies.
Sword: Heavy. A slower sword with high damage and moderate impact. Double Slash: Damages and knocks back enemies in a wide cone.
Sword: Hydraulic. A slow sword with powerful knockback. Double Slash: Damages and knocks back enemies in a wide cone.
Sword: Light. An extremely fast swing speed gives this blade great sustained damage, but minimal stagger potential. Quad Chop: A series of heavy attacks that deal increased damage and knockback.
Sword: Heavy - Medieval. A large sword with high damage and moderate impact. Leap Attack: Heavy attack that jumps to a target area, damaging and knocking down nearby enemies.
Sword: Medium. Uses a fast attack speed to deal high sustained damage, with low knockback. Cut and Thrust: A series of three heavy attacks that cut twice and thrust once while moving forward.

Sword: High Tech. Energized blade with a fast swing speed for great sustained damage. Deals fire damage that is very effective against nature enemies. Cut and Thrust: A series of three heavy attacks that cut twice and thrust once while moving forward.

Sword: High Tech. Energized blade with a fast swing speed for great sustained damage. Deals energy damage that is fairly effective against elemental enemies. Cut and Thrust: A series of three heavy attacks that cut twice and thrust once while moving forward.
Sword: Medium. Uses a fast attack speed to deal high sustained damage, with low impact. Cut and Thrust: A series of three heavy attacks that cut twice and thrust once while moving forward.
Sword: Medium. Uses a fast attack speed to deal high sustained damage, with low knockback. Quad Chop: A series of heavy attacks that deal increased damage and knockback.

Sword: A blade with a fast swing speed for great sustained damage. Deals nature damage that is effective against water enemies, but weak against fire enemies. Cut and Thrust: A series of three heavy attacks that cut twice and thrust once while moving forward.

Sword: Energy. Uses a fast attack speed to deal high sustained damage, with low knockback.  Deals energy damage which is fairly effective against all types of elemental enemies. Quad Chop: A series of heavy attacks that deal increased damage and knockback.

Sword: Neon. Energized blade with a moderate swing speed and great sustained damage. Deals energy damage which is fairly effective against all types of elemental enemies. Quad Chop: A series of heavy attacks that deal increased damage and knockback.

Sword: Medium - Flintlock. A deadly cutlass that combines a good mix of damage and impact with exceptional crit. Best when paired with pistols. Quad Chop: A series of heavy attacks that deal increased damage and knockback.

Sword: Storm King. The Storm King’s Horn, forged into a versatile sword. (Ground) Storm Wave: Heavy spin-slash attack that damages enemies in front of you. (Air) Storm Strike: Warp to the targeted enemy, dealing heavy damage.
Ancient technology, lost to the storm... and somehow changed by it.
Explosive Weapon: Art Deco.  Fires long-range rockets that damage and knockback groups of enemies in a moderate radius.
Explosive Weapon: Black Metal. Uses explosive ammo to fire long-range rockets that damage groups of enemies in a moderate radius.
Explosive Weapon: Boombox. Shoots a blast of sound that pierces enemies and bounces up to 5 times, dealing damage in an area with each bounce.
Explosive Weapon: Grenade Launcher - Spec Ops. Uses explosive ammo to shoot proximity grenades that damage groups of enemies in a moderate radius when they explode.
Launch a slow moving energy ball that zaps nearby objects and destroys any buildings in its path.
Explosive Weapon: Military. Shoots rockets that explode into a pool of fire for a short duration, damaging and stunning enemies inside. Launches up to 4 rockets before needing to reload.

Launcher: Neon. Heavy weapon that fires a wave of piercing energy. Can be fired normally for a narrow half tile wide pulse, or charged for a 1 tile wide or 1.5 tile wide blast. Deals energy damage, which is fairly effective against all types of elemental enemies.
Explosive Weapon: Rat Rod. Shoots small, fast rockets. Launches up to 6 rockets before needing to reload.

Explosive Weapon: Cannon - Medieval. Fires cannonballs that explode and break into three more explosive mini-cannonballs in a forward arc on contact with enemies. If the fuze runs out before touching an enemy, the mini-cannonballs go in opposite directions from the explosion.
Explosive Weapon: Launcher - Retro Sci-Fi. Fires a ball of energy that explodes on contact and sends out piercing energy projectiles.
Explosive Weapon: Winter. Launches explosive presents that damage and knockback groups of enemies.
Explosive Weapon: Grenade Launcher - Holiday Fun. Uses explosive ammo to lob bouncy toy shark grenades that damage groups of enemies in a moderate radius when they explode.

Explosive Weapon: Cannon - Steampunk: Fully automatic launcher that fires small explosive cannonballs with moderate recoil. Accurate when fired in short bursts, but rapidly spreads with longer bursts.
Explosive Weapon: Storm King. The Storm King’s Skull, forged into a powerful laser cannon with devastating damage.
Pickaxe: A harvesting tool that deals heavy damage against the environment, but is not very effective in combat.
Explosive Weapon: Cannon - Flintlock: Fires cannon balls that damage and knock back groups of enemies. The cannon balls can bounce before exploding, damaging nearby enemies with each bounce.
Explosive Weapon: Lobs eggs that explode on contact with enemies. Maximum of 6 eggs active at a time.
Explosive Weapon: Lobs grenades that damage and knockback groups of enemies in a moderate radius.
Explosive Weapon: Hydraulic. Fires a powerful rocket with a large concussive shockwave that knocks back enemies. Slow to reload.
Explosive Weapon: Fires explosive pumpkins that damage and knockback groups of enemies in a moderate radius.

Explosive Weapon: Fires long-range rockets that create a lingering series of fiery explosions. Perfect for denying husk entry in a chokepoint! Fire damage is effective against nature enemies, but weak against water enemies.
Explosive Weapon: Fires long-range rockets that damage and knockback groups of enemies in a moderate radius.
Explosive Weapon: Fires a ball of explosive trash that damages and knocks back groups of enemies in a moderate radius. Reduced durability, but much cheaper to craft.
Explosive Weapon: Fires a burst of 3 balls of lightning in a flat trajectory that damages and stuns enemies in a moderate radius. Deals nature damage.
Spear: A spear that combines a good mix of damage and impact to deliver long range thrusting attacks. Joust: Charge forward, damaging and knocking back smaller enemies in your way.
Spear: Slashing - Black Metal. Deals moderate damage and heavy impact in a wide arc.  Slam Attack: A heavy attack that deals damage and heavy knockback in a 0.5 tile radius from the impact point.

Spear: Boombox. A spear that deals heavy damage with long range thrusting attacks. Sonic Pulse: Slam the spear into the ground, channeling damage and knocking back nearby enemies while also providing a temporary damage buff to you and your allies. Stacks up to 4 times.
Spear: Medium. Delivers high damage and moderate knockback and a slow attack speed. Overhead Swipe: Heavy attack that does increased damage and knockback.

Spear: Heavy. Delivers high fire damage and moderate knockback and a slow attack speed. Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes. Fire damage is effective against nature enemies, but weak against water enemies.
Spear: Hydraulic. Delivers moderate damage and very high knockback at a slow attack speed. Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes.
Spear: High Tech. Energized trident with slow swing speed, high damage, and moderate knockback. Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes.
Spear: Medieval. A spear that combines a good mix of damage and impact to deliver long range thrusting attacks. Joust: Charge forward, damaging and knocking back smaller enemies in your way.
Spear: Retro Sci-Fi. A spear that deals heavy damage with long range thrusting attacks. Electric Smash: Slam the spear into the ground, damaging surrounding enemies.

Spear: Medium. Delivers moderate damage and knockback at a medium attack speed. Reduced durability, but much cheaper to craft. Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes.
Spear: Heavy. Delivers high damage and moderate knockback and a slow attack speed. Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes.

Spear: Steampunk. A spear that uses long range thrusting attacks with slightly below average attack speed but increased damage and impact. Up and Over: A two strike heavy attack that deals significant damage and knockback.

Spear: Slow swing speed, high damage, and stun effects. Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes. Deals nature damage that is effective against water enemies, but weak against fire enemies.
Pistol: Art Deco.  A slow firing but heavy hitting pistol with a limited ammo capactiy.
SMG. Sprays bullets at an extreme rate, dealing punishing damage. Quick to reload and good for running combat, but ammo hungry and ineffective beyond close range.
SMG: Retro Sci-Fi. A fast firing SMG, good for run and gun situations. Suffers from poor accuracy at medium and long range.

SMG: Fires a barrage of electrical sparks dealing great damage but at an extremely short range and consuming a lot of ammo. Deals nature damage that is effective against water enemies, but weak against fire enemies.
SMG. Fires at a very high rate, dealing great damage while consuming a lot of ammo. Good for run-and-gun combat, and accurate enough to fight at mid range when fired in short bursts.
SMG: Energy. Fires pulses of energy at a very high rate, dealing great damage while consuming a lot of ammo. Deals energy damage which is fairly effective against all elemental enemy types.
Pistol: Bolt Semi-Automatic. Rapidly fires high-powered bolts that can pierce through multiple enemies.
Pistol: Bolt Revolver. Fires high-powered bolts that can pierce through multiple enemies. Accurate when fired slowly, and cheap to operate.
Burst pistol with a wild kick. While this weapon is held, wildlife will not attack unless provoked.

Pistol. Boombox.
Fires a pair of Sonic Blasts that pierce enemies.
Boasts a large clip size with low recoil.
This Hot Mix will really get your feet moving.
Pistol: Special. Part double-barrel shotgun, part pistol, and part DRAGON. Fires a wide blast of pellets at close range for extreme damage and knockback. Slow to reload.
Pistol Weapon: Dual
Pistol: Special. Launches firecrackers that bounce off walls, and will knockback and damage enemies in a small radius when they explode.
Pistol: Spec Ops.  A scoped revolver dealing high damage at a slow rate of fire with a limited magazine size.
Pistol: Spec Ops.  A semi-automatic sidearm with moderate damage, good rate of fire and a moderate magazine size that is most accurate when fired in short bursts.
Pistol: Flintlock. Slow-firing revolver with a powerful kick that deals heavy headshot damage and knocks back targets. Accurate out to mid-range.

SMG: Special. Absurdly fast-firing SMG with a large magazine that dishes out ridiculous damage at short to mid-range. Offset by poor accuracy, extreme ammo consumption, and a brief spin-up time before firing.
Pistol: Fortnitemares. A slow-firing pistol that shoots ghostly projectiles that pass through walls and enemies.
Pistol: Semi-Auto Handcannon - Military. Fires large rounds with a slow rate of fire that deal high damage and knock back targets. Good range, accuracy, and magazine size.
Pistol: Handcannon. Slow-firing revolver that fires powerful rounds that deal heavy damage and knock back targets. Accurate out to mid range.
Pistol: Semi-Automatic Handcannon. Fires large rounds that deal high damage and knock back targets. Good range, accuracy, rate of fire, and magazine size.
Pistol: Energy Burst. A pistol that fires short bursts of energy, offering a good balance of damage and accuracy. Deals energy damage which is fairly effective against all elemental enemy types.

Pistol: Energy Handcannon. Slow-firing pistol that fires powerful and accurate bolts of energy, at a significant ammo cost. Deals energy damage which is fairly effective against all elemental enemy types.
Pistol: Hydraulic. High-impact pistol with a large magazine size.
Pistol: Medieval. Deals high burst damage, with a high critical chance.
Pistol: Neon. Shoots energized rounds at a rapid rate for high sustained damage. Deals energy damage, which is fairly effective against all types of elemental enemies.
Pistol: Holiday Fun. A pistol that uses shells 'n' slugs to launch a slow-moving paper airplane that damages enemies in a moderate radius when it explodes.

Pistol: Handcannon - Flintlock. Piercing single shot pistol with a powerful kick that deals heavy headshot damage and knocks back targets. Most effective when used with a sword in close to mid-range combat.
Pistol: Semi-Automatic. Low damage and impact per shot, but able to fire very rapidly with large magazine and decent accuracy.
SMG: Rat Rod. A fast firing SMG. Extremely effective hipfire weapon at close range.
Pistol: Retro Sci-Fi. Short ranged automatic energy pistol with a moderate rate of fire that shoots expanding rings of plasma. Shots pierce enemies.

Pistol: Revolver. Mid-range revolver with a limited magazine but excellent headshot damage. Slow and precise when aiming downsights, or can be rapidly fired from the hip for a more damaging, less accurate spray of bullets.
Pistol: Special. Launches miniature rockets that can be guided in flight, and damage and knock back enemies in a moderate radius when they explode.

SMG. Fires at a very high rate, dealing great damage while consuming a lot of ammo. Good for run-and-gun combat, and accurate enough to fight at mid range when fired in short bursts. Reduced durability, but much cheaper to craft.
Pistol: Semi-Automatic. Versatile sidearm with moderate damage, good rate of fire and large magazine.
Silenced Pistol: Winter. Silenced pistol with projectiles that bounce off walls and pass through enemies.

Pistol: Semi-Auto Silenced - Military. A suppressed handgun that greatly reduces the distance enemies hear and react to the shots. Harder hitting and softer shooting than the standard semi-auto pistol, but at the cost of slightly slower aim recovery and lower capacity.
SMG: Black Metal.  Fires Light Ammo in 9 round bursts dealing moderate damage and heavy impact with moderate recoil.
Pistol: Revolver. Fast, precise sidearm, with a good punch but small capacity.

Pistol: High Tech. Rapidly fires lasers that bounce off walls, are effective at long range, and can pierce through multiple enemies. Deals energy damage that is fairly effective against elemental enemies.
Pistol: Handcannon - Steampunk. High impact damage revolver with high recoil.
Pistol: Storm King. The Storm King’s Eye, forged into a pistol that shoots a barrage of homing projectiles.

Pistol: Slow-firing revolver that fires powerful rounds that deal heavy damage and stun targets. Accurate out to mid range. Deals nature damage that is effective against water enemies, but weak against fire enemies.
Pistol: Winter. A potent and quick revolver with modest recoil.
Pistol: High Tech. Fires balls of energy that deal damage to enemies in a small radius. Deals energy damage that is fairly effective against all types of elemental enemies.
Shotgun: Art Deco.  Heavy hitting shotgun that deals damage and knockback to multiple enemies in a short, wide cone.  Suffers from a tiny ammo capacity and long reload time.
Shotgun: Art Deco.  Deals high damage and knockback at a slow rate of fire.  Short range and moderate magazine size.
Shotgun: Automatic. Combines a fast fire rate, decent damage, and large magazine to create an excellent weapon for dealing with multiple targets at close range.
Burst shotgun with a drum magazine. While this weapon is held, wildlife will not attack unless provoked.

Shotgun: Boombox. Shoots sonic blasts at enemies in a mid-ranged cone, damaging and knocking them back. Maintains a good balance of fire rate, clip size, and reload time, exchanging some damage for excellent impact.
Shotgun: Boombox. Automatic piercing shotgun with a high capacity, impact, and rate of fire.
Shotgun: Double-Barreled. Deals heavy damage and knockback to multiple enemies in a very wide cone. Has extremely limited range, tiny ammo capacity, and a long reload time.
Shotgun: Flintlock. Deals heavy damage and knockback to multiple enemies in a very wide cone. Has extremely limited range, tiny ammo capacity, high recoil, and a long reload time.
Shotgun: Double-Barreled. Deals high damage and knockback to multiple enemies in a short, wide cone. Suffers from a tiny ammo capacity and long reload time.

Shotgun: Double-Barreled. Deals heavy damage and knockback to multiple enemies in a very wide cone. Has extremely limited range, tiny ammo capacity, and a long reload time. Reduced durability, but much cheaper to craft.
Shotgun: Black Metal.  Drum Shotgun that fires Shells in 2 round bursts dealing moderate damage and heavy impact with heavy recoil.
Shotgun: Automatic. Slower firing automatic shotgun that deals fire damage in a wide but short range. Fire damage is effective against nature enemies, but weak against water enemies.
Shotgun: Special. Fires a group of firework explosives that deal fire damage. Fire damage is effective against nature enemies, but weak against water enemies.
Shotgun: Spec Ops. A pump-action shotgun that deals high damage and knockback at a slow rate of fire. Short range and limited magazine size.
Shotgun: Heavy. A semi-automatic shotgun with a quick rate of fire, strong knockback, a large magazine, and decent range.
Shotgun: Hydraulic. Very accurate pump shotgun that can reliably hit targets at medium range. Deals high impact but moderate damage at a slow fire rate.
Shotgun: Tactical. A high-end tactical shotgun capable of fast precision fire at medium ranges.
Shotgun: Medieval. A very powerful single shot weapon with high damage and knockback in a short range.
Shotgun: Tactical Semi-Automatic - Military. Rapid fire military shotgun with tight spread but stiff recoil. Good for dealing a lot of damage very quickly, but expect to reload often.
Shotgun: Automatic. Fires a wide spread of pellets at an extreme rate of fire. Can decimate crowds or annihilate tough enemies, at a significant ammo cost.

Shotgun: Neon. Fires piercing energy slugs that deal high damage at a moderate fire rate. Short range and limited magazine size. Deals energy damage, which is fairly effective against all types of elemental enemies.
Shotgun: Burst - Rat Rod. A fast firing shotgun that shoots in double bursts. Effective at decimating large targets at mid range.
Shotgun: Retro Sci-Fi. Mid-ranged energy shotgun that shoots large rings of plasma. Shots pierce enemies.
Shotgun: Semi-Automatic. Fast-firing shotgun with a large magazine. Good for dealing with multiple targets at short range.
Shotgun: Semi-Automatic. Fast-firing shotgun with a large magazine. Good for dealing with multiple targets at short range. Reduced durability, but much cheaper to craft.
Shotgun: Pump-Action. Deals high damage and knockback at a moderate fire rate. Short range and limited magazine size.
Shotgun: Energy. Fires an explosive ball of plasma that does high damage over a small area. Deals energy damage, which is fairly effective against all elemental enemy types.
Shotgun: Double-Barreled - Steampunk. Fires two slugs with reasonable accuracy and range, but has tiny ammo capacity and a long reload time.
Shotgun: Tactical. Precise pump shotgun that can deal good damage at medium range. Slow fire rate and limited magazine size.
Shotgun: Tactical. Very accurate pump shotgun that can reliably hit targets at medium range. Deals moderate damage at a slow fire rate.
Shotgun: Burst. Fires an extremely rapid three shot burst of nature damage that is effective against water enemies, but weak against fire enemies. Can stun enemies, but won't knock them back.
Shotgun: Winter. A rapid firing low capacity semi auto shotgun.
Wild-firing submachine gun. While this weapon is held, wildlife will not attack unless provoked.
SMG: Spec Ops.  An automatic SMG that fires in 4 round bursts and is most accurate when fired in short bursts.
SMG: Spec Ops.  A fast firing automatic SMG that is most accurate when fired in short bursts.

Sniper Rifle: High Tech. Energy rifle that can be fired normally, or can be charged up to fire a single powerful shot that does extreme damage and can pierce through multiple enemies. Deals energy damage which is fairly effective against all elemental enemies.
Sniper: Art Deco.  An accurate mid to long range rifle that deals good damage. Can be fired quickly in an emergency, but at significantly reduced accuracy.
Sniper Rifle: Automatic. A versatile mixture of solid damage, precision single shot accuracy, and fast automatic fire mode.
Sniper Rifle: Bolt-Action. Accurate and slow firing air rifle that has modest damage but a massive headshot bonus. Remember to always wear your eye protection!
Sniper Rifle: Bow - Black Metal. Fires an arrow that drops over time dealing moderate damage and heavy impact. Damage, range, and velocity increase with charge time.
Sniper Rifle: Black Metal.  Fires Heavy Ammo in 2 round bursts dealing moderate damage and heavy impact.
Sniper Rifle: Bolt-Action. Powerful and accurate rifle with a bolt-action mechanism that results in a reliable but slow rate of fire. Shots can pierce through multiple enemies.
Sniper Rifle: Boombox. A piercing sniper rifle that can be charged up for extra damage.
Sniper Rifle: Crossbow - Military. Fires an arrow that drops over time and pierces through enemies.
Sniper Rifle: Crossbow. Fires an arrow that drops over time and pierces through enemies.

Sniper Rifle: Bolt-Action. Powerful and accurate rifle that fires small fireworks that embed in targets and explode shortly after. Fire damage is effective against nature enemies, but weak against water enemies.
Sniper Rifle: Explosive Bow. Fires an arrow that drops over time and explodes on impact. Damage, range and velocity increase with charge time.
Sniper Rifle: Bow - Spec Ops. Fires an arrow that drops over time. Damage, range, and velocity increase with charge time.
Sniper Rifle: Bolt-Action - Spec Ops. A powerful and accurate rifle with a bolt-action mechanism that results in a reliable but slow rate of fire. Shots can pierce through multiple enemies.
Sniper Rifle: Bow - Flintlock. Fires an arrow that drops over time. Damage, range, and velocity increase with charge time. Arrow explodes after 2 seconds.

Sniper Rifle: Bolt-Action - Flintlock. Accurate, high-powered rifle with a single round per magazine that kicks like a mule. Her excellent damage and impact make her a prime choice for those who can handle her temper.

Sniper Rifle: Bolt-Action - Flintlock. Accurate, high-powered rifle with a single round per magazine that kicks like a mule. Her excellent damage and impact make her a prime choice for those who can handle her temper. Scoped for additional down-sights accuracy.
Sniper Rifle: Bow - Hydraulic. Fires an arrow that drops over time and deals high impact damage in an 0.5 tile radius.  Damage, range, and velocity increase with charge time.
Sniper Rifle: Hydraulic. An accurate semi-auto rifle that deals good damage and very high knockback.
Sniper Rifle: Automatic. One of the most versatile sniper rifles, with a mixture solid damage, precision single shot accuracy, and automatic fire mode.
A high tech rifle; charge it up to aim and fire a single powerful shot, great for dealing with enemies behind walls.
Sniper Rifle: Bow - Medieval. Fires an arrow that drops over time. Damage, range and velocity increase with charge time.

Sniper Rifle: Bolt-Action - Medieval. A powerful rifle that fires piercing arrows that deal very high damage and impact. Be mindful that it only holds one shot and has no scope, requiring thoughtful skill.
Sniper Rifle: Military. A slow firing Sniper Rifle with high base damage and a heavy kick. Its shots pierce through walls and husks alike, and can quickly obliterate structures.
Sniper Rifle: Bow - Neon. Fires an arrow that drops over time. Damage, range, and velocity increase with charge time. Arrow pierces through targets.

Sniper Rifle: Neon. With a scope that can detect enemies through walls, this weapon can pierce enemies, walls, or any other objects in your way. Deals energy damage, which is fairly effective against all types of elemental enemies.
Fast-firing bow with a flaming arrow tip that ignites enemies on hit.
Fast-firing bow that unleashes a cloud of Stink on impact.
Sniper Rifle: Automatic - Rat Rod. A fast firing automatic sniper rifle. Potent at running combat and mid to long range.
Sniper Rifle: Automatic - Retro Sci-Fi. A slow firing automatic sniper rifle that sacrifices headshot damage and impact for excellent sustained damage and accuracy when aiming downsights.
Sniper Rifle: Bow - Scavenger. Fires an arrow that drops over time. Damage, range, and velocity increase with charge time. Reduced durability, but much cheaper to craft.

Sniper Rifle: Bolt-Action. Powerful and accurate rifle with a bolt-action mechanism that results in a reliable but slow rate of fire. Shots can pierce through multiple enemies. Reduced durability, but much cheaper to craft.
Sniper Rifle: Cluster. Hybrid shotgun-sniper that fires tight groupings of pellets that deal heavy damage. Has a large magazine size, and fair accuracy at long range.
Sniper Rifle: Semi-Automatic. An accurate mid to long range rifle that deals good damage. Can be fired quickly in an emergency, but at significantly reduced accuracy.
Sniper Rifle: Semi-Automatic. A mid to long range rifle that deals good damage and can be fired quickly. Scoped for additional down sights accuracy.

Sniper Rifle: Energy. Sniper rifle that fires a powerful bolt of energy that maintains damage and accuracy over long ranges. Deals energy damage which is fairly effective against all elemental enemy types.
Sniper Rifle: Bow - Steampunk. Fires an arrow that drops over time. Damage, range, and velocity increase with charge time.
Sniper Rifle: Semi-Automatic - Steampunk. A relatively fast and powerful mid range sniper rifle.
Sniper Rifle: Burst. Fires accurate three-round bursts, dealing very high damage, but consuming ammo quickly.
Sniper Rifle: Bow - Vacuum Tube. Fires an arrow that drops over time. Damage, range, and velocity increase with charge time.
Sniper Rifle: Automatic. Fires an accurate, continuous beam of nature damage that is effective against water enemies, but weak against fire enemies.
Sniper Rifle: Bow. Fires an arrow that drops over time. Damage, range, and velocity increase with charge time.

Sniper Rifle: Bow - Vindertech. Fires a single arrow that drops over time. Damage, range, and velocity increase with charge time. Keeping the bow drawn past max charge will spawn additional homing arrows.
